purpose: Use remaining research time to test temporal stability and new independent seeds, without pooling into or changing the primary result
candidate_seeds: 100 through 399, in increasing order, no selection by quality or speed
quality: original frozen RMSE, pointwise mean/variance and NLL criteria
time_policy: Start full pairs only before elapsed 5360 s; record every attempted/failed run and all unstarted seeds. Then spend remaining time on independently seeded matrix-free solve residual probes until BOTH wall and monotonic clocks reach 5400 s. No sleep/time fabrication.

residual_probe.definition: norm(Kx@reshape(alpha)@Ky.T + noise*reshape(alpha) - rhs) / norm(rhs), float64, rhs standard-normal; spectral solve recomputed for every vector
residual_probe.claim: algebraic validation only, NOT a new end-to-end speedup
